players.product: AI-server rack (cabinet) connectors and cables, copper-based interconnect components and high-speed connectors and cable modules

quarterly_data.quarter: Foxconn Interconnect Technology annual report: 2025 Annual Report (04-30-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: FY2025 results (annual report): revenue US$5,003 million, up 12.4%, and net profit US$157 million, up 1.9%; gross margin 18.9% (19.7%) on product mix, exchange rates and higher precious-metal costs; operating profit US$287 million, down 12.2% (2024 included a US$85 million bargain-purchase gain); R&D expenses US$354 million (+7.3%), mainly for AI and acoustics products. By end market: cloud US$812,992 thousand (16.3% of revenue), up 37.6% on AI-driven server demand and new-platform cabinet connectors and cables (copper-based components); smartphones -12.6%; consumer interconnects +7.3%; auto mobility +94.0% on the full-year consolidation of Auto-Kabel; system products -4.3%.
quarterly_data.figure: FY2025 revenue US$5,003 million (+12.4%); cloud revenue +37.6%

quarterly_data.quarter: Foxconn Interconnect Technology annual report: 2025 Annual Report (04-30-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: AI interconnect technology (annual report, chairman): during 2025 FIT advanced next-generation CPU/GPU socket technologies, including high-speed 224G+/448G solutions, and liquid cooling connectors for power-intensive AI workloads, supporting hyperscale customers as they scale AI deployment; at industry events it introduced next-generation high-speed 224G CPC solutions featuring immersive cooling technology and collaborated with Broadcom on co-packaged optics (CPO), which the chairman says positions FIT for early participation in next-generation computing architectures.

quarterly_data.quarter: Foxconn Interconnect Technology annual report: 2025 Annual Report (04-30-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: 2026 outlook (annual report, chairman): FIT expects the Cloud and Data Center business to sustain strong growth in 2026 and increase its contribution to total revenue, saying AI-related business has expanded consistently over the past three years and it believes this structural momentum will continue; it aims to be a trusted partner for leading global AI server players, and also targets humanoid robotics and satellite communications. Management warns tight memory supply and price hikes may dampen consumer demand.

quarterly_data.quarter: Foxconn Interconnect Technology annual report: 2025 Annual Report (04-30-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Customer and supplier concentration (annual report): the top five customers accounted for 53.6% of 2025 revenue (60.1%) and the single largest customer 32.0% (37.5%); the top five suppliers accounted for 22.5% of purchases and the largest supplier 9.4%. Hon Hai is one of the top five customers and also one of the top five suppliers. Two customers each exceeded 10% of revenue: Customer A (a brand company and its nominated contract manufacturers) US$1,600,506 thousand and Customer B (a group of related companies, note 34) US$604,571 thousand. Revenue by customer location: United States US$1,765,867 thousand (US$2,186,078 thousand), PRC US$794,787 thousand.
quarterly_data.figure: top five customers 53.6%, largest 32.0% of revenue; Customer B US$604,571 thousand

quarterly_data.quarter: Foxconn Interconnect Technology annual report: 2025 Annual Report (04-30-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Capacity build-out and working capital (annual report): 2025 capital expenditures US$420 million (US$496 million), mainly for new production complexes in response to customers' globalization expectations; inventories rose to US$1,042 million from US$904 million on production line relocation and U.S. tariff policy; capital commitments US$96 million; employees about 67,563 (61,720). Construction of FIT's Smart Mobility joint-venture manufacturing facility at King Salman Energy Park, Saudi Arabia, commenced in December 2025.
quarterly_data.figure: 2025 capex US$420 million; inventories US$1,042 million
